changes: DICTIONARY now uses the common version-aware object body/string bounds resolver also used by DICTIONARYVAR.
Dictionary mode fields are decoded through one version table for plain and default dictionaries.
Common-object, dictionary-entry, and default-entry handle roles share bounded role predicates while preserving relative soft-pointer rules and typed-null behavior.

AC1012 and AC1014 inline bodies must end exactly at their declared boundary; AC1012 DICTIONARYVAR now validates common handle roles and qualifies its tail only when byte alignment is the sole remainder.
AC1012 and AC1014 DICTIONARY and DICTIONARYVAR now require a nonzero declared inline object-data boundary before validating the decoded body.
